releases.title: Height units and saved display preference
changes: Show tag and floor heights in centimeters, with feet and inches in parentheses.
Add a saved Show English units preference; switch it off for centimeters only.
Keep recorded geometry in meters and preserve the current calibration when changing display units.

releases.title: Automatic tag height above the floor
changes: Show a live height estimate beside every detected tag ID after selecting the floor once.
Prefer usable LiDAR depth at the detected tag center, with a labeled pose estimate when depth is unavailable.
Keep the source frame, floor reference and height provenance with tag detections; hide heights when their inputs are stale or invalid.

releases.title: Floor planes and persistent 3D measurements
changes: Show detected horizontal surfaces and select a floor for vertical height measurements.
Keep completed distance and floor-height vectors anchored in the scene while moving the phone.
Save measurement geometry and floor provenance with recordings; hide overlays during limited tracking and clear live placement when the AR coordinate frame resets.
Keep AR tag-width measurement separate from completed measurement history.

releases.title: Single-line camera controls
changes: Combine tracking status, depth status and view zoom on one compact line over the camera.
Retain pinch zoom and the 1×, 2× and 4× controls while freeing vertical camera space.

releases.title: Camera view zoom
changes: Pinch to magnify the live view from 1× to 4×, or use the 1×, 2× and 4× buttons.
Keep tag outlines and pose axes aligned, with measurement taps mapped back to the original image.
Keep original camera frames, LiDAR samples and pose calculations unchanged; view zoom does not switch lenses or add optical detail.

releases.title: Build identification and release notes
changes: Show the installed app version, build number, source revision and UTC build date, with release notes available from the header.
Save the version, build, source revision and UTC build date with each new session.
Retain the compact camera overlay, expandable diagnostics and optional tag pose axes.

releases.title: Compact overlay and optional pose axes
changes: Keep the camera preview full size with a translucent compact readout and expandable Details.
Add optional red, green and blue tag pose axes, disabled by default.
Preserve existing measured tag widths when introducing the new preference.

releases.title: Tag pose and LiDAR diagnostics
changes: Show selected-tag camera-relative position, angles, range, reprojection error and matched LiDAR depth comparison.
Add configurable quality thresholds and manual or reviewed AR-measured tag widths.
Preserve measured-width precision when editing other settings.

releases.title: Tag overlay stability
changes: Fix the crash when clearing tag outlines and labels by preserving UIKit-owned views and layers.
Keep recordings and existing capture formats unchanged.

releases.title: Live AprilTag detection
changes: Detect tag36h11 IDs and draw corner outlines while viewing the live camera, independently of recording.
Record frame-linked detections, corner coordinates and decode quality on a bounded native worker.

releases.title: Initial iPhone capture app
changes: Add the native ARKit and LiDAR capture workflow with RGB media, numeric depth, confidence and frame metadata.
Add bookmarks, two-point measurements, saved sessions and ZIP sharing through iOS.
